annotations.title: CPR 21.10 approval checklist (infant and protected party settlements)

description: Checks when a settlement, interim payment or payment in by or for a child or protected party needs the court's approval in England and Wales (CPR 21.10; PD 21 was revoked in 2023), the route (a Part 8 claim before issue, or an application in the proceedings), the documents for the approval hearing, the court fee, investment of the money (CPR 21.11, the Court Funds Office forms and the Court of Protection for £100,000 or more) and the rules on deductions from damages (CPR 21.12, 46.4). It never values the claim or works out a costs or deduction figure.

band.description: The sum agreed, as a band (the rules turn on these; no figure is worked out): "up-to-5k" (£5,000 or less), "up-to-25k" (More than £5,000, up to £25,000), "under-100k" (More than £25,000, under £100,000), "100k-plus" (£100,000 or more).

deductions.description: Whether costs or expenses will be claimed out of the damages (CPR 21.12): "yes" (Yes), "no" (No), "unsure" (Not sure).

dependency.description: A sum is apportioned to a dependent child (CPR 21.10(7)).

dob.description: Optional: the child's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD).

existingAuthority.description: A deputy or a registered attorney already manages the protected beneficiary's finances (CPR 21.11(9)(b)).

funding.description: How the claim is funded: "cfa" (A conditional fee agreement (CFA)), "dba" (A damages based agreement (DBA)), "legal-aid" (Legal aid (publicly funded)), "other" (Another way, or not known).

futureLoss.description: The claim includes damages for future financial loss (CPR 21.10(4)).

manageMoney.description: Protected party: lacks capacity to manage the money; child: likely to remain unable to at 18: "yes" (Yes), "no" (No), "unsure" (Not sure).

party.description: Who the settlement is for: "child" (A child (under 18)), "protected" (A protected party (lacks capacity to conduct the proceedings)).

personalInjury.description: A personal injury claim arising from an accident (CPR 21.10(3)(f)).

protocolFixedCosts.description: Section IV of Part 45 applies (the RTA and EL/PL protocol fixed costs, CPR 21.10(6)).

side.description: Their side of the claim: "claimant" (Their claim), "defendant" (A claim against them).

stage.description: Whether proceedings have been issued: "before" (Before proceedings were issued), "issued" (In proceedings already issued).

what.description: What needs approval: "settlement" (A settlement or compromise, including accepting a Part 36 offer), "interim" (A voluntary interim payment), "payment-in" (Accepting money paid into court).
